response.description:
OpenTelemetry metrics and visualizations in Azure Monitor are generally
available, delivering an enhanced, unified monitoring experience for Azure
Virtual Machines and Arc Servers. This release consolidates key monitoring
capabilities into a single experience and introduces a simplified onboarding
experience, helping customers more efficiently observe, diagnose, and optimize
their environments. Previously, VM monitoring visualizations were powered by metric data
from Log Analytics which continues to be fully supported. Customers now also
have the option to power these visualizations using OpenTelemetry (OTel) Gues OS metrics, offering a more cost-efficient and performant solution.  With this release, you can: Reduce
     monitoring costs and improve troubleshooting efficiency with faster
     metric query response times using OTel metrics Simplify
     setup with a unified onboarding experience, including support for selecting
     existing Data Collection Rules (DCRs) Onboard
     and configure monitoring at scale through the Monitoring Coverage, ARM templates, or Bicep templates Enable
     recommended alerts to accelerate issue detection and reduce
     configuration overhead Leverage
     Dashboards with Grafana for at-scale visibility and per-process
     insights across your VM environments Learn more: https://aka.ms/vmiv2docs   Collect
and customize OpenTelemetry metrics for Azure virtual machines - Azure Monitor
response.title: Generally Available: OpenTelemetry Metrics, Visualizations, and Enhanced Monitoring in Azure Monitor for Azure VMs and Arc Servers
